description: Screenshots dressed to share, like the site’s Screen Frame: inside a drawn browser window (title bar with three dots and an address), phone, tablet or laptop, or as a plain rounded card, on a gradient, colour, blurred copy, image or transparent background, at a social canvas size. Devices keep their real screen shape; screenshots are cropped to fill them from the top. Saved next to the originals as name-framed.png (or .jpg). The frames are simple drawings, not any maker’s artwork. [Pro tool.]

background.description: Behind the frame: a gradient, one colour, a soft blurred copy of the screenshot, an image, or nothing (transparent PNG).

background_image.description: Image file for background "image" (cropped to fill).

canvas.description: Canvas: square 2160×2160, portrait 2160×2700 (4:5), portrait-34 2160×2880, story 2160×3840 (9:16), landscape 3840×2160, og 2400×1260 (link preview), dribbble 1600×1200, custom (width × height), or auto (fits the mockup plus padding).

files.description: Image files or folders (a folder means the images in it). ~ is your home folder.

format.description: PNG keeps text in the screenshot crisp; JPEG makes smaller files. A transparent background is always PNG.

frame.description: The frame. "plain" is the screenshot with rounded corners and a shadow, no device.

gradient.description: Built-in gradient: lime, dusk, graphite, paper, sea, peach.

gradient_colours.description: Your own two-colour gradient (hex), top left to bottom right. Overrides "gradient".

notch.description: Phone: the camera pill at the top of the screen.

orientation.description: Phone and tablet: upright, on their side, or turned to match each screenshot. A laptop is always landscape.

output_dir.description: Folder to save results in. Default: next to each original. Originals are never overwritten.

padding.description: Space around the device, as a % of the canvas’s shorter side.

shadow.description: A soft shadow under the device.

style.description: "textured": surfaces lit from the top left. "flat": solid colours, no sheen.

tone.description: Frame colour: "dark", "light", or any hex colour for the device.

url.description: Text for the browser’s address bar, e.g. example.com. Empty leaves the bar blank.

name: frame_screenshots
title: Frame screenshots
